ModMetaData.name: Milira Race - Float Menu Fix
ModMetaData.author: Vorsel
ModMetaData.description:
【中文说明】
【问题发现】 在一个启用了数百个 Mod 的存档中逐项排查后，我发现 Milira Race 和 Milira: Wings of Democracy 都会让地图右键菜单在开启期间持续占用较多性能。两个问题是在同一轮排查中发现的，但来自不同 Mod、对应不同代码路径，因此分别制作了两个独立的 Fix Mod。
随后使用 Codex 检查 RimWorld 1.6 的 FloatMenu 调用链和 Milira Race 程序集，并结合性能日志与 A/B 测试定位了以下问题。
【主要修复】
1. 无关目标触发日光燃料 WorkGiver Milira_EmptySunLightFuelContainer 会在菜单重验证时扫描地图上的 Thing。原版物品、地面和物品架也可能反复触发它。
修复：先检查右键目标，只有真正带有日光燃料生成组件的建筑才进入原逻辑。预期可消除普通物品和物品架产生的大部分额外开销。
2. 日凌聚光塔重复搜索储存位置 对有产物的日凌聚光塔生成菜单时，原逻辑会在 HasJobOnThing 和 JobOnThing 中重复寻找储存位置，并随菜单持续重验证。
修复：短期缓存聚光塔的最终菜单结果，同时继续检查建筑和产物状态。预期可明显降低菜单保持开启时的持续耗时，提取功能保持不变。
【本机测试，仅供参考】 • 单格物品架放满：约 70 FPS → 大部分时间超过 140 FPS • 有产物的日凌聚光塔：约 105–110 FPS → 约 135–140 FPS
以上结果来自本机存档和 MSI Afterburner，不代表所有电脑、存档及 Mod 列表都能获得相同提升。
【兼容性与存档】 补丁通过 Harmony 运行，只调整右键菜单检查，不修改 Milira Race 原文件、普通 AI 工作扫描或存档数据。理论上可以中途加入或移除；更改后请完整重启游戏，并正常备份重要存档。
本补丁只处理 Milira Race，不包含 Wings of Democracy 或 Milira Imperium 的修复。
【开发说明】 问题定位、调用链调查和补丁代码由 Codex 协助完成；性能数据与功能验证由我在游戏内实际测试。
【English Description】
【Issue】 While isolating mods in a save with several hundred entries, I found that Milira Race could add substantial sustained cost while a map float menu remained open. The slowdown generally became worse when more Things occupied the clicked cell, even when those Things were unrelated to Milira Race.
Codex was used to inspect the RimWorld 1.6 FloatMenu call chain and the Milira Race assembly. Performance logs and repeated A/B tests identified the following hot paths.
【Main fixes】
1. Solar-fuel WorkGiver checks on unrelated targets Milira_EmptySunLightFuelContainer could scan map Things during menu revalidation, even for ordinary items, cell targets, and storage buildings.
Fix: a lightweight prefilter allows only buildings with the solar-fuel generator component to enter the original logic. This is expected to remove most of the extra cost from ordinary items and storage menus.
2. Repeated storage searches for the Solar Energy Conversion Collection Tower For a tower containing output, HasJobOnThing and JobOnThing both searched for storage while the menu was continuously revalidated.
Fix: the final tower menu result is briefly cached while the building and output state are still checked. Extraction behavior remains unchanged.
【Local test results — reference only】 • Filled single-cell storage: about 70 FPS → usually above 140 FPS • Tower containing output: about 105–110 FPS → about 135–140 FPS
These MSI Afterburner results come from one local setup and will vary with hardware, saves, and mod lists.
【Compatibility】 This Harmony patch only adjusts float-menu checks. It does not modify Milira Race files, normal AI work scans, or save data. It should be safe in theory to add or remove mid-save; fully restart the game after changing the mod list and keep normal backups.
This patch targets Milira Race only. Wings of Democracy and Milira Imperium require separate fixes.
【Development】 Codex assisted with call-chain investigation and implementation. Performance measurements and gameplay validation were performed in game by the author.
